        INTEGER :: x !Iterators
        REAL(8),DIMENSION(LOOPCOUNT):: a, b, c !Data

        !Initilization
        SEEDDIM(1) = 1

        SEEDDIM(1) = SEED
#       endif

            errors = errors + 1
          END IF
        END DO

        IF (errors .eq. 0) THEN
          test1 = .FALSE.

          failed = failed .or. test1()

        IF (failed) THEN
          failcode = failcode + 2 ** 0
          failed = .FALSE.
